definition: Estimated first- and later-language speakers where available; no native/second-language split.

languages.name: Chinese
languages.note: CLDR reports Chinese (zh), not a Mandarin-only census. Traditional-script Chinese is a separate entry; these categories may overlap and are not combined.

languages.name: Traditional Chinese
languages.note: Traditional-script Chinese is reported separately in CLDR. Script categories can overlap with Chinese (zh); do not add them together.
